units: <cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 4:1">Meg. IV, 1</cite> <he>בש׳</he> on the second day of the week.
<cite ref="Megillah 22a:9">Ib. 22ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Taanit 27b:14">Taan. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>הש׳ קורא וכ׳</he> the second (of those called to read from the Law) reads &c.
<cite ref="Beitzah 6a:1">Bets. 6ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>יום טוב ש׳</he> the second (Rabbinical) Holy Day (instituted on account of the uncertainty of the calendar).

<cite ref="Shabbat 40b:8">Sabb. 40ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>כלי ש׳</he> second vessel, i.e. a vessel into which a boiling mass has been poured, contrad. to <he>כלי ראשון</he> a vessel direct from the fire.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Maaser Sheni 1:1">Maas. Sh. I, 1</cite>, a. fr. <he>מעשר ש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M02188"><he>מַעֲשֵׂר</he></cite>.—Esp.

senses.gloss: (לטומאה) ש׳ the second degree of levitical uncleanness, an object made unclean through contact with uncleanness, v. רִאשׁוֹן.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 2:2">Toh. II, 2</cite> <he>האוכל … אוכל ש׳ ש׳</he> he that eats food unclean in the second degree, becomes unclean in the second degree.

<cite ref="Pesachim 14a:6">Pes. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>ש׳ וש׳ הוא וכ׳</he> it is a contact between two things both unclean in the second degree, and why do you say that he adds to the degree of uncleanness?; a. fr.—
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: relationship in the second degree, second generation.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 28a:17">Snh. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>ש׳ בש׳ תנן</he> we have learned that a relative in the second degree (first cousin) cannot testify for or against a relative in the second degree; <he>ש׳ בראשון תנן</he> we have learned that one of the second generation cannot testify for or against one of the first generation, i.e. his uncle.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 28a:17">Ib.</cite> <he>שלישי בש׳</he> a relative in the third degree against one in the second degree, i.e. his father’s first cousin; a. fr.—Pl. <he>שְׁנִיִּים</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yadayim 2:2">Yad. II, 2</cite> <he>ואת הש׳ למקום אחר</he> and water poured over his hands a second time on another place.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yadayim 2:2">Ib.</cite> <he>ועל הש׳ טהור</he> and a loaf which fell on the place which received the second water is clean.
Gen. R. s. 31 ש׳ לו וכ׳ the second story of the ark was for him (Noah) and his sons and the clean animals; a. fr.—Fem. שְׁנִיָּה, שְׁנִיָּיה.
Ab. Zar. 3ᵇ ש׳ during the second three hours of the day; a. fr.—Esp. שניה (sub. לערוה) incest of second degree, intermarriage forbidden by rabbinical enactment.
<cite ref="Yevamot 21b:16">Yeb. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>אמו ערוה אם אמו ש׳</he> connection with one’s mother is incest, with one’s mother’s mother incest in the second degree.
Ib. משום ש׳ as incest of the second degree; a. fr.—Pl. as above.

Ib.ᵃ מה הם ש׳ what relationships are sh’niyoth? Ib. (ref. to Lev. XVIII, 27) האל … מאי נינהו ש׳ haël means the severe, which implies that there are milder forms of incest; what are they? The sh’niyoth; a. fr.
senses.label: b
